$comment: Optional cart-drawer brand tweak. The managed cart drawer already inherits your theme tokens; use this only for small overrides. The CSS is applied scoped to the drawer's own root, so it cannot affect the rest of the page. Reference theme tokens (var(--color-*), var(--font-*), var(--radius-*)) rather than hard-coded values so it tracks your theme. Confirm the exact wiring with `tot validate`.
